recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, minimalist composition featuring a large-scale silhouette of a man's head and shoulders in the foreground, facing a line of uniformed figures in the distance. The upper half is dominated by bold, stacked sans-serif typography on a clean white background, while the lower half uses a grainy, black-and-white photograph with a low horizon line.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the large foreground silhouette and the small background figures
Color-coded hierarchy between the primary red title and secondary blue subtitle
Vertical division between the clean graphic top and the gritty photographic bottom
Symmetrical balance centered on the vertical axis of the foreground figure
coreInvariants: Over-the-shoulder perspective looking toward a horizon
Tri-color palette of red, blue, and black on white
Grainy, high-contrast black and white photographic texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large silhouette centered in the lower foreground, occupying approximately 40% of the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starts at the red title, moves to the blue subtitle, then follows the silhouette's gaze toward the line of figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the upper half provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Red (primary title) and Navy Blue (secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation primary colors for text; zero-saturation photography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same-family or similar-weight sans-serifs, differentiated by color and scale.

preserve: Condensed nature of the top word

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the main title.
Suitable for the geometric, clean look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph. In the foreground, a large silhouette of the back of a man's head and shoulders. In the distant background, a long line of uniformed police officers standing on a road. The top half of the image must be pure solid white negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold, condensed sans-serif title in crimson red at the top center. Below it, add a two-line subtitle in navy blue using a bold geometric sans-serif, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the top half solid white?
Is the foreground figure a dark silhouette?
Are the two text blocks distinct in color (red and blue)?
Is the photography grainy and black and white?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red and blue
Vertical position of the horizon line
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the silhouette

mustAchieve: Clean separation between graphic and photographic zones

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is significantly larger than the blue text.
Ensure the silhouette is centered and crisp against the white background.
Verify the photographic grain is visible but not obscuring the forms.
Confirm all text is uppercase and sans-serif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W over-the-shoulder photo in the bottom third with bold, bi-color centered sans-serif typography in the top two-thirds white space.
